Sometimes, it just calls it without saying anything, likely misinterpreting the previous transcript as answering.

Sometimes, there's a double response from the candidate:

```
<enter task1 - "Are you legally authorized...">
agent: Are you legally authorized to work in the united states?
user: Yes
<enter task2 - "Do you have reliable transportation...">
user: Yes
<enter task3 - even though agent didn't ask question in task2>
```

Using data points should make this better, but we'll still struggle from this for back to back confirmations.

* Don't allow the transition if the agent hasn't said anything in its current task. e.g. in the above, the tool call to transition to `task3` should throw a `ToolError("You haven't asked the question to the candidate yet")` since there's no agent message.

* We might want to make it harder to interrupt the agent on their first message in a task - e.g. set min interruption words to 2 or 3.

```
<enter task1 - "Are you legally authorized...">
agent: Are you legally authorized to work in the united states?
user: Yes
<enter task2 - "Do you have reliable transportation...">
user: Yes
<enter task3 - even though agent didn't ask question in task2>
```

input.title: Expand voice agent v3 infrastructure to pro max
input.description:
Scale the Voice Agent v3 infrastructure to handle production-level "pro max" capacity and performance requirements.

## Acceptance Criteria
- Infrastructure scaled to support high-volume concurrent calls
- Performance benchmarks defined and met
- Monitoring and alerting configured for scaled infrastructure
- Load testing completed successfully

input.title: Setup a phone number programmatically for voice agent v3
input.description:
Implement programmatic phone number provisioning and configuration for Voice Agent v3 deployments.

## Acceptance Criteria
- API endpoint or service to provision new phone numbers
- Automatic configuration of phone numbers with routing agent
- Support for different phone number types (toll-free, local, etc.)
- Integration with existing phone number provider APIs

Note: Related to PUR-1032 but focuses on production programmatic setup rather than test configuration.

input.title: Setup fallback for routing agent when unable to find candidate or opportunity
input.description:
Implement fallback behavior in the routing agent when it cannot match a call to a candidate or opportunity.

## Acceptance Criteria
- Define fallback behavior (e.g., transfer to human, generic message, log for follow-up)
- Implement error handling for missing candidate/opportunity data
- Configure appropriate messaging for callers
- Log incidents for monitoring and debugging
- Test edge cases thoroughly

Related to PUR-1104 but specifically handles the fallback scenario.

input.title: Configure legacy agent to not call on outbound if a flag in metadata exists
input.description:
Add capability to prevent legacy agent from making outbound calls based on a metadata flag.

## Acceptance Criteria
- Define metadata flag structure and naming convention
- Implement flag checking in legacy agent's outbound call logic
- Ensure backward compatibility with existing calls without the flag
- Add logging for skipped calls due to metadata flag
- Document the flag usage for operations team

input.title: Setup legacy agent instance that works with current routing agent
input.description:
Configure a legacy agent instance that can be dispatched by the current routing agent for backward compatibility.

## Acceptance Criteria
- Legacy agent instance configured and deployed
- Integration with routing agent's dispatch logic
- Proper handoff mechanism between routing and legacy agents
- Maintain existing legacy agent functionality
- Test interoperability between agents

This enables gradual migration while maintaining support for legacy features.

input.title: Configure engagement response to determine which agent to dispatch
input.description:
Implement logic to use engagement response data to dynamically determine which agent (v3, legacy, or specialized) should handle a call.

## Acceptance Criteria
- Define engagement response criteria for agent selection
- Implement dispatch logic based on engagement data
- Support for multiple agent types (v3, legacy, specialized)
- Fallback logic if engagement data is unavailable
- Performance monitoring for dispatch decisions

Builds upon PUR-1028 and PUR-1038 work.

input.title: Configure existing phone number programmatically to go from legacy agent to routing agent
input.description:
Implement migration path to programmatically reconfigure existing phone numbers from legacy agent to the new routing agent.

## Acceptance Criteria
- API or script to migrate phone number configurations
- Support for bulk migration of multiple numbers
- Rollback capability in case of issues
- Zero-downtime migration process
- Validation and testing of migrated configurations
- Documentation for operations team on migration process
